Explicit punctured tube with full-turn meridian and pure axial period L>0 is an essential hypothesis, stronger than identity holonomy. In Cartesian coordinates (sinh²r-r²)/r⁴=1/3+O(r²) extends smoothly and positive-definitely; cosh²r smooth in r². Curvature extends by continuity and core length L. Reader extension-supplier/F4/3.1 repair correctly handles arbitrary topological gluing by transported atlas; finite disjoint ends independent. No unsupported claim of global completeness in this local lemma. Statement unchanged.

Current capped mapping torus and H1 action checked. Read all four steps and exact slope/longitude/plumbing/extension interfaces. Boundary of the open-book fiber is primitive and nullhomologous, hence preferred longitude up to sign; integer 0 means that slope. Model filling caps by disk with identity extension of boundary-fixing monodromy; actual attaching map differs by meridian-preserving boundary homeomorphism and extends. Capped H1 matrix remains [[2,1],[1,1]]. Reader F7/3.1 repair sound and needed to cover arbitrary maps, not only asserted meridional twists. AC implies supplier CC. Statement unchanged; no further interface propagation.

Full AC stated and direct supplier CC hypotheses met. Reader F5 tag correctly identifies already supplied cover/partition inputs.
